name: Daito Me Holdings Co., Ltd
summary: Daito Me Holdings Co., Ltd, alongside its group of companies, specializes in the production and distribution of electronic components and mechanical machinery across Japan and Taiwan. Their product portfolio is extensive, featuring integrated computing systems; complete mechanical assemblies such as control panels, coils, and robotic arm solutions; and a range of individual components like CPU motherboards, various control equipment parts, servo motors, power units, and connectors. Furthermore, the company is actively involved in the fabrication, processing, and commerce of copper foil circuit boards and adhesive films. Established in 1957, the firm's primary corporate base is located in George Town, Cayman Islands.
